lines.en: They just forgot to unlock the door, that's all.
Ron, it looks like they're closed.
Some kind of health code violation.
They just boarded her up like she was some common warehouse.
What happened to the stakes that were in there when they closed?
Do you think they got eaten?
Why don't we go back to my place and I'll fire up the grill?
You sure you're not expecting company or something?
Go back to my place and make you some grub.
It'll be just as good as it would have been here.
Ron, would you like some salad?
Since I am not a rabbit, no, I do not.
Try it. Sounds good for you.
Hey, Ann, if you get this, I don't know if you should come up here.
Just call me, let me know where you are, and if you have...
What in the devil's name is this?
Can you get us a cold conference or something?
Why would you call it that on your menu?
I don't know what to tell you, man.
Just give me all the bacon and eggs you have.
I worry what you just heard was,
give me a lot of bacon and eggs.
give me all the bacon and eggs you have.
